items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was named after the Ellington vocalist.

ctx.x: You were in the Lionel Hampton orchestra and when you finished your time with that orchestra, you decided to go back to Arizona, where you were going to go traveling and you stopped off in Arizona.
Well, I thought I'd mention some of the experiences about that in the after-hours spots in Los Angeles.
There used to be a place called Ivie Anderson's --
